subject: Next steps & success metrics for Snowline pilot
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alex Brown <alex.brown@snowline.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Snowline pilot — post-demo recap & draft success metrics

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the time today — quick recap and a proposed set of pilot success metrics and next steps so we can land on scope.

Pilot scope (2 weeks):
- Workloads: 50k inference calls/day simulated (peak 120 rps)
- Primary model: open-llm/snowline-7B-quant (we'll propose a compatible variant if capacity constrained)

Success metrics (initial targets):
- Latency: p95 < 300 ms (propose relaxing to 350 ms for first run; see reply below)
- Throughput: sustain 120 req/s with <= 5% request drop under peak
- Cost: effective cost/token <= $0.0012
- Quality: top-level QA metrics — intent F1 >= 0.85 on your annotated holdout; hallucination rate < 3% (manual spot checks)

Evaluation plan:
1) Week 0 — dataset handoff (customer provides 3-5k labeled examples + production sample)
2) Week 1 — smoke tests + synthetic load, collect latency/cost/quality baselines
3) Week 2 — production-like runs, measurement against success gates

Ownership:
- Redwood: Ben Carter (ops lead) — infra, run harness, measurements
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (CS) — onboarding, quality validation
- Snowline: Alex Brown — dataset handoff, business signoff

Requested next steps:
- Alex: confirm dataset delivery by 2026-02-22 and identify two product SMEs
- We'll schedule a dry-run on 2026-02-28 and kickoff on 2026-03-01

Attachments: Snowline_POC_Scope.pdf (PDF), POC_Metric_Template.xlsx (Excel)

I'll follow up with a short Doc with owners and dates — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz | Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 16:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Snowline pilot — post-demo recap & draft success metrics

Thanks Vanessa — great recap.

A couple quick asks/notes:
- We can deliver the annotated holdout by 2026-02-22; I'll loop Priya (data lead) to the thread.
- Latency: for our production constraints, can we aim for p95 <= 350 ms for week 1 and iterate toward 300 ms in week 2? We're okay with that tradeoff if cost stays predictable.
- Please share the metric template and a sample run output format so our SMEs know what to validate.

Proposed kickoff: 2026-03-01. Priya Shah (priya.shah@snowline.ai) will coordinate datasets.

Attachments: snowline_dataset_manifest.csv (CSV)
